description: LWW-Element-Set CRDT implements strict > instead of >=, violating specified add-bias resolution on timestamp ties.
spec_notes: LWWElementSet.lookup must evaluate add_ts >= rem_ts for add-bias tie breaking.

tests.test_crdt_convergence.py:
from replica import ReplicaNode
from lww_element_set import LWWElementSet


def test_equal_timestamp_add_bias():
    s = LWWElementSet()
    t = 100.0
    s.add("item_1", t)
    s.remove("item_1", t)
    # Add bias must return True on identical add and remove timestamps
    assert s.lookup("item_1") is True


def test_replica_convergence():
    r1 = ReplicaNode("r1")
    r2 = ReplicaNode("r2")
    r1.set_crdt.add("x", 50.0)
    r2.set_crdt.remove("x", 40.0)
    # Synchronize
    r1.sync_with(r2)
    r2.sync_with(r1)
    assert r1.set_crdt.lookup("x") is True
    assert r2.set_crdt.lookup("x") is True
